verses.original: ἄρα νῦν Οὐδὲν κατάκριμα τοῖς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: ara nyn Ouden katakrima tois en Christō Iēsou
verses.literal: Therefore [there is] now no condemnation for those who [are] in Christ Jesus

verses.original: γὰρ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ ὁ νόμος τοῦ Πνεύματος τῆς ζωῆς σε ἠλευθέρωσέν ἀπὸ τοῦ νόμου τῆς ἁμαρτίας καὶ τοῦ θανάτου
verses.transliteration: gar en Christō Iēsou ho nomos tou Pneumatos tēs zōēs se ēleutherōsen apo tou nomou tēs hamartias kai tou thanatou
verses.literal: For in Christ Jesus the law of the Spirit of life {set} you free from the law - of sin and - death

verses.original: γὰρ τὸ τοῦ νόμου ἀδύνατον ἐν ᾧ ἠσθένει διὰ τῆς σαρκός ὁ Θεὸς πέμψας ἑαυτοῦ τὸν Υἱὸν ἐν ὁμοιώματι ἁμαρτίας σαρκὸς καὶ περὶ ἁμαρτίας κατέκρινεν τὴν ἁμαρτίαν ἐν τῇ σαρκί
verses.transliteration: gar to tou nomou adynaton en hō ēsthenei dia tēs sarkos ho Theos pempsas heautou ton Huion en homoiōmati hamartias sarkos kai peri hamartias katekrinen tēn hamartian en tē sarki
verses.literal: For what the law was powerless to do in that it was weakened by the flesh - God [did] by sending His [own] Son in [the] likeness of sinful man - [ as an offering ] for sin He [thus] condemned - sin in the flesh

verses.original: ἵνα τὸ δικαίωμα τοῦ νόμου πληρωθῇ ἐν ἡμῖν τοῖς μὴ περιπατοῦσιν κατὰ σάρκα ἀλλὰ κατὰ πνεῦμα
verses.transliteration: hina to dikaiōma tou nomou plērōthē en hēmin tois mē peripatousin kata sarka alla kata pneuma
verses.literal: so that the righteous standard of the law might be fulfilled in us who {do} not walk according to [the] flesh but according to [the] Spirit

verses.original: γὰρ Οἱ ὄντες κατὰ σάρκα φρονοῦσιν τὰ τῆς σαρκὸς δὲ οἱ κατὰ πνεῦμα τὰ τοῦ πνεύματος
verses.transliteration: gar Hoi ontes kata sarka phronousin ta tēs sarkos de hoi kata pneuma ta tou pneumatos
verses.literal: - Those who live according to [the] flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh but those [who live] according to [the] Spirit [set their minds on] the things of the Spirit

verses.original: γὰρ τὸ φρόνημα τῆς σαρκὸς θάνατος δὲ τὸ φρόνημα τοῦ πνεύματος ζωὴ καὶ εἰρήνη
verses.transliteration: gar to phronēma tēs sarkos thanatos de to phronēma tou pneumatos zōē kai eirēnē
verses.literal: - The mind of the flesh [is] death but the mind of the Spirit [is] life and peace

verses.original: διότι τὸ φρόνημα τῆς σαρκὸς ἔχθρα εἰς Θεόν γὰρ οὐχ ὑποτάσσεται τῷ τοῦ Θεοῦ νόμῳ γὰρ οὐδὲ δύναται
verses.transliteration: dioti to phronēma tēs sarkos echthra eis Theon gar ouch hypotassetai tō tou Theou nomō gar oude dynatai
verses.literal: because the mind of the flesh [is] hostile to God - vvv It does not submit to - God’s law vvv nor can it [do so]

verses.original: δὲ οἱ ὄντες ἐν σαρκὶ οὐ δύνανται ἀρέσαι Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: de hoi ontes en sarki ou dynantai aresai Theō
verses.literal: - Those - controlled by [the] flesh vvv cannot please God

verses.original: Ὑμεῖς δὲ ἐστὲ οὐκ ἐν σαρκὶ ἀλλὰ ἐν πνεύματι εἴπερ Πνεῦμα Θεοῦ οἰκεῖ ἐν ὑμῖν δέ εἰ τις οὐκ ἔχει Πνεῦμα Χριστοῦ οὗτος οὐκ ἔστιν αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Hymeis de este ouk en sarki alla en pneumati eiper Pneuma Theou oikei en hymin de ei tis ouk echei Pneuma Christou houtos ouk estin autou
verses.literal: You however are vvv controlled not by [the] flesh but by [the] Spirit if [the] Spirit of God lives in you And if anyone {does} not have [the] Spirit of Christ he {does} not belong to [Christ]

verses.original: δὲ εἰ Χριστὸς ἐν ὑμῖν μὲν τὸ σῶμα νεκρὸν διὰ ἁμαρτίαν δὲ τὸ πνεῦμα ζωὴ διὰ δικαιοσύνην
verses.transliteration: de ei Christos en hymin men to sōma nekron dia hamartian de to pneuma zōē dia dikaiosynēn
verses.literal: But if Christ [is] in you - [your] body [is] dead because of sin yet [your] spirit [is] alive because of righteousness

verses.original: δὲ εἰ τὸ Πνεῦμα τοῦ ἐγείραντος τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἐκ νεκρῶν οἰκεῖ ἐν ὑμῖν ὁ ἐγείρας Χριστὸν Ἰησοῦν ἐκ νεκρῶν καὶ ζωοποιήσει ὑμῶν θνητὰ τὰ σώματα διὰ αὐτοῦ Πνεύματος τοῦ ἐνοικοῦντος ἐν ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: de ei to Pneuma tou egeirantos ton Iēsoun ek nekrōn oikei en hymin ho egeiras Christon Iēsoun ek nekrōn kai zōopoiēsei hymōn thnēta ta sōmata dia autou Pneumatos tou enoikountos en hymin
verses.literal: And if the Spirit of Him who raised - Jesus from [the] dead is living in you He who raised Christ Jesus from [the] dead vvv will also give life to your mortal - bodies through His Spirit who lives in you

verses.original: Ἄρα οὖν ἀδελφοί ἐσμέν ὀφειλέται οὐ τῇ σαρκὶ τοῦ ζῆν κατὰ σάρκα
verses.transliteration: Ara oun adelphoi esmen opheiletai ou tē sarki tou zēn kata sarka
verses.literal: Therefore . . . brothers we have [an] obligation [but it is] not to the flesh - to live according to [it]

verses.original: γὰρ εἰ ζῆτε κατὰ σάρκα μέλλετε ἀποθνήσκειν δὲ εἰ πνεύματι θανατοῦτε τὰς πράξεις τοῦ σώματος ζήσεσθε
verses.transliteration: gar ei zēte kata sarka mellete apothnēskein de ei pneumati thanatoute tas praxeis tou sōmatos zēsesthe
verses.literal: For if you live according to [the] flesh you will die but if by [the] Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body you will live

verses.original: γὰρ ὅσοι ἄγονται Πνεύματι Θεοῦ οὗτοι εἰσιν υἱοί Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: gar hosoi agontai Pneumati Theou houtoi eisin huioi Theou
verses.literal: For all who are led by [the] Spirit of God - are sons of God

verses.original: γὰρ Οὐ ἐλάβετε πνεῦμα δουλείας πάλιν εἰς φόβον ἀλλὰ ἐλάβετε πνεῦμα υἱοθεσίας ἐν ᾧ κράζομεν Ἀββᾶ ὁ Πατήρ
verses.transliteration: gar Ou elabete pneuma douleias palin eis phobon alla elabete pneuma huiothesias en hō krazomen Abba ho Patēr
verses.literal: For vvv you did not receive a spirit of slavery that returns you to fear but you received [the] Spirit of adoption to sonship by whom we cry Abba - Father

verses.original: τὸ Πνεῦμα αὐτὸ συμμαρτυρεῖ ἡμῶν τῷ πνεύματι ὅτι ἐσμὲν Θεοῦ τέκνα
verses.transliteration: to Pneuma auto symmartyrei hēmōn tō pneumati hoti esmen Theou tekna
verses.literal: The Spirit Himself testifies with our - spirit that we are God’s children

verses.original: δὲ εἰ τέκνα καὶ κληρονόμοι κληρονόμοι μὲν Θεοῦ δὲ συνκληρονόμοι Χριστοῦ εἴπερ συμπάσχομεν ἵνα καὶ συνδοξασθῶμεν
verses.transliteration: de ei tekna kai klēronomoi klēronomoi men Theou de synklēronomoi Christou eiper sympaschomen hina kai syndoxasthōmen
verses.literal: And if [we are] children then [we are] heirs heirs - of God and co-heirs with Christ if indeed we suffer with [Him] so that vvv we may also be glorified with [Him]

verses.original: γὰρ Λογίζομαι ὅτι τὰ τοῦ νῦν καιροῦ παθήματα οὐκ ἄξια πρὸς τὴν δόξαν μέλλουσαν ἀποκαλυφθῆναι εἰς ἡμᾶς
verses.transliteration: gar Logizomai hoti ta tou nyn kairou pathēmata ouk axia pros tēn doxan mellousan apokalyphthēnai eis hēmas
verses.literal: - I consider that [our] - present . . . sufferings [are] not comparable to the glory that will be revealed in us

verses.original: τῆς κτίσεως ἀπεκδέχεται ἡ γὰρ ἀποκαραδοκία τὴν ἀποκάλυψιν τῶν υἱῶν τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: tēs ktiseōs apekdechetai hē gar apokaradokia tēn apokalypsin tōn huiōn tou Theou
verses.literal: The creation waits - - in eager expectation for the revelation of the sons - of God

verses.original: γὰρ ἡ κτίσις ὑπετάγη τῇ ματαιότητι οὐχ ἑκοῦσα ἀλλὰ διὰ τὸν ὑποτάξαντα ἐφ’ ἑλπίδι
verses.transliteration: gar hē ktisis hypetagē tē mataiotēti ouch hekousa alla dia ton hypotaxanta eph’ helpidi
verses.literal: For the creation was subjected to futility not by its own will but because of the [One who] subjected [it] in hope

verses.original: ὅτι ἡ κτίσις αὐτὴ καὶ ἐλευθερωθήσεται ἀπὸ τῆς δουλείας τῆς φθορᾶς εἰς τὴν τῆς δόξης ἐλευθερίαν τῶν τέκνων τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: hoti hē ktisis autē kai eleutherōthēsetai apo tēs douleias tēs phthoras eis tēn tēs doxēs eleutherian tōn teknōn tou Theou
verses.literal: that the creation itself - will be set free from [its] bondage - to decay [and brought] into the vvv glorious freedom of the children - of God

verses.original: γὰρ Οἴδαμεν ὅτι ἡ πᾶσα κτίσις συστενάζει καὶ συνωδίνει ἄχρι τοῦ νῦν
verses.transliteration: gar Oidamen hoti hē pasa ktisis systenazei kai synōdinei achri tou nyn
verses.literal: - We know that the whole creation has been groaning together - in the pains of childbirth until - the present time

verses.original: οὐ μόνον δέ ἀλλὰ ἡμεῖς αὐτοὶ καὶ ἔχοντες τὴν ἀπαρχὴν τοῦ Πνεύματος καὶ στενάζομεν αὐτοὶ ἐν ἑαυτοῖς ἀπεκδεχόμενοι υἱοθεσίαν τὴν ἀπολύτρωσιν ἡμῶν τοῦ σώματος
verses.transliteration: ou monon de alla hēmeis autoi kai echontes tēn aparchēn tou Pneumatos kai stenazomen autoi en heautois apekdechomenoi huiothesian tēn apolytrōsin hēmōn tou sōmatos
verses.literal: Not only that but we ourselves - who have the firstfruits of the Spirit - groan inwardly . . . . . . as we wait eagerly for [our] adoption as sons the redemption of our - bodies

verses.original: γὰρ τῇ ἐλπίδι ἐσώθημεν δὲ ἐλπὶς βλεπομένη ἔστιν οὐκ ἐλπίς γὰρ τις τί ἐλπίζει ὃ βλέπει
verses.transliteration: gar tē elpidi esōthēmen de elpis blepomenē estin ouk elpis gar tis ti elpizei ho blepei
verses.literal: For in this hope we were saved but hope that is seen is no hope [at all] - [Who] . . . hopes for what he can already see

verses.original: δὲ εἰ ἐλπίζομεν ὃ οὐ βλέπομεν ἀπεκδεχόμεθα δι’ ὑπομονῆς
verses.transliteration: de ei elpizomen ho ou blepomen apekdechometha di’ hypomonēs
verses.literal: But if we hope for what vvv we do not yet see we wait for [it] vvv patiently

verses.original: δὲ Ὡσαύτως καὶ τὸ Πνεῦμα συναντιλαμβάνεται ἡμῶν τῇ ἀσθενείᾳ γὰρ οὐκ οἴδαμεν τὸ τί καθὸ δεῖ προσευξώμεθα ἀλλὰ τὸ Πνεῦμα αὐτὸ ὑπερεντυγχάνει στεναγμοῖς ἀλαλήτοις
verses.transliteration: de Hōsautōs kai to Pneuma synantilambanetai hēmōn tē astheneia gar ouk oidamen to ti katho dei proseuxōmetha alla to Pneuma auto hyperentynchanei stenagmois alalētois
verses.literal: - In the same way . . . the Spirit helps us in our - weakness For vvv we do not know - how vvv we ought to pray but the Spirit Himself intercedes [for us] with groans too deep for words

verses.original: δὲ ὁ ἐραυνῶν τὰς καρδίας οἶδεν τί τὸ φρόνημα τοῦ Πνεύματος ὅτι ἐντυγχάνει ὑπὲρ ἁγίων κατὰ Θεὸν
verses.transliteration: de ho eraunōn tas kardias oiden ti to phronēma tou Pneumatos hoti entynchanei hyper hagiōn kata Theon
verses.literal: And He who searches [our] hearts knows - the mind of the Spirit because [the Spirit] intercedes for [the] saints according to [the will] [of] God

verses.original: δὲ Οἴδαμεν ὅτι ὁ θεὸς συνεργεῖ πάντα εἰς ἀγαθόν τοῖς ἀγαπῶσιν τὸν Θεὸν τοῖς οὖσιν κλητοῖς κατὰ πρόθεσιν
verses.transliteration: de Oidamen hoti ho theos synergei panta eis agathon tois agapōsin ton Theon tois ousin klētois kata prothesin
verses.literal: And we know that - God works all things together . . . for [the] good of those who love - [Him] who are called according to [His] purpose

verses.original: ὅτι οὓς προέγνω καὶ προώρισεν συμμόρφους τῆς εἰκόνος τοῦ αὐτοῦ Υἱοῦ εἰς αὐτὸν τὸ εἶναι πρωτότοκον ἐν πολλοῖς ἀδελφοῖς
verses.transliteration: hoti hous proegnō kai proōrisen symmorphous tēs eikonos tou autou Huiou eis auton to einai prōtotokon en pollois adelphois
verses.literal: For those [God] foreknew vvv He also predestined [to be] conformed to the image of His Son so that He - would be [the] firstborn among many brothers

verses.original: δὲ οὓς προώρισεν τούτους καὶ ἐκάλεσεν καὶ οὓς ἐκάλεσεν τούτους καὶ ἐδικαίωσεν δὲ οὓς ἐδικαίωσεν τούτους καὶ ἐδόξασεν
verses.transliteration: de hous proōrisen toutous kai ekalesen kai hous ekalesen toutous kai edikaiōsen de hous edikaiōsen toutous kai edoxasen
verses.literal: And those He predestined - vvv He also called - [those] He called - vvv He [also] justified - [those] He justified - vvv He also glorified

verses.original: Τί οὖν ἐροῦμεν πρὸς ταῦτα εἰ ὁ Θεὸς ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν τίς καθ’ ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: Ti oun eroumen pros tauta ei ho Theos hyper hēmōn tis kath’ hēmōn
verses.literal: What then shall we say in response to these things If - God [is] for us who [can be] against us

verses.original: γε ὅς ἐφείσατο οὐκ τοῦ ἰδίου Υἱοῦ ἀλλὰ παρέδωκεν αὐτόν ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν πάντων πῶς οὐχὶ καὶ σὺν αὐτῷ χαρίσεται ἡμῖν πάντα τὰ
verses.transliteration: ge hos epheisato ouk tou idiou Huiou alla paredōken auton hyper hēmōn pantōn pōs ouchi kai syn autō charisetai hēmin panta ta
verses.literal: - He who did not spare . . . [His] own Son but gave Him up for us all how {will He} not also along with Him freely give us all things

verses.original: τίς ἐγκαλέσει κατὰ Θεοῦ ἐκλεκτῶν Θεὸς ὁ δικαιῶν
verses.transliteration: tis enkalesei kata Theou eklektōn Theos ho dikaiōn
verses.literal: Who will bring any charge against God’s elect [It is] God [who] justifies

verses.original: τίς ὁ κατακρινῶν Χριστὸς Ἰησοῦς ὁ ἀποθανών δὲ μᾶλλον ἐγερθείς ὅς ἐστιν ἐν δεξιᾷ τοῦ Θεοῦ ὃς καὶ καί ἐντυγχάνει ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: tis ho katakrinōn Christos Iēsous ho apothanōn de mallon egertheis hos estin en dexia tou Theou hos kai kai entynchanei hyper hēmōn
verses.literal: Who [is] there to condemn [us] [For] Christ Jesus who died and more than that was raised to life - is at [the] right hand - of God - and - He is interceding for us

verses.original: Τίς χωρίσει ἡμᾶς ἀπὸ τῆς ἀγάπης τοῦ Χριστοῦ θλῖψις ἢ στενοχωρία ἢ διωγμὸς ἢ λιμὸς ἢ γυμνότης ἢ κίνδυνος ἢ μάχαιρα
verses.transliteration: Tis chōrisei hēmas apo tēs agapēs tou Christou thlipsis ē stenochōria ē diōgmos ē limos ē gymnotēs ē kindynos ē machaira
verses.literal: Who shall separate us from the love - of Christ {Shall} trouble or distress or persecution or famine or nakedness or danger or sword

verses.original: καθὼς γέγραπται ὅτι Ἕνεκεν σοῦ θανατούμεθα ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν ἐλογίσθημεν ὡς πρόβατα σφαγῆς
verses.transliteration: kathōs gegraptai hoti Heneken sou thanatoumetha holēn tēn hēmeran elogisthēmen hōs probata sphagēs
verses.literal: As it is written - For Your sake . . . we face death all - day long we are considered as sheep to be slaughtered

verses.original: Ἀλλ’ ἐν πᾶσιν τούτοις ὑπερνικῶμεν διὰ τοῦ ἀγαπήσαντος ἡμᾶς
verses.transliteration: All’ en pasin toutois hypernikōmen dia tou agapēsantos hēmas
verses.literal: No in all these things we are more than conquerors through Him who loved us

verses.original: γὰρ πέπεισμαι ὅτι οὔτε θάνατος οὔτε ζωὴ οὔτε ἄγγελοι οὔτε ἀρχαὶ οὔτε ἐνεστῶτα οὔτε μέλλοντα οὔτε δυνάμεις
verses.transliteration: gar pepeismai hoti oute thanatos oute zōē oute angeloi oute archai oute enestōta oute mellonta oute dynameis
verses.literal: For I am convinced that neither death nor life neither angels nor principalities neither the present nor the future nor any powers

verses.original: οὔτε ὕψωμα οὔτε βάθος οὔτε τις ἑτέρα κτίσις δυνήσεται χωρίσαι ἡμᾶς ἀπὸ τῆς ἀγάπης τοῦ Θεοῦ τῆς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ ἡμῶν τῷ Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: oute hypsōma oute bathos oute tis hetera ktisis dynēsetai chōrisai hēmas apo tēs agapēs tou Theou tēs en Christō Iēsou hēmōn tō Kyriō
verses.literal: neither height nor depth nor anything else in all creation will be able to separate us from the love - of God that [is] in Christ Jesus our - Lord
